description: This file contains platform-specific shell functions for handling device detection, image verification, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying within an embedded Linux environment, specifically tailored for a certain hardware architecture.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Determines the boot device based on the current kernel command line parameters and environment.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the image's partition layout matches the current device's layout to decide if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, including image writing, partition management, and u-boot environment preservation.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the boot partition from the backup location.
